text: Mia is allergic to peanuts and carries an EpiPen.
Mia's sister Lena lives in Montreal and works as a nurse.
Mia started a new job at Northwind Analytics as a data analyst in September.
Mia's manager at Northwind is Raj; they have a weekly 1:1 every Tuesday at 10am.
Mia takes oat milk in her coffee and usually orders a flat white.
Mia goes bouldering at Grip Gym on Monday and Thursday evenings.
Mia has a dentist appointment on November 14 at 3:30pm.
Mia adopted a rescue cat named Biscuit in July.
Biscuit needs thyroid pills twice a day, morning and night.
Mia practises Japanese on Duolingo every morning and has a 120-day streak.
Mia is planning a trip to Kyoto in April with her partner Sam.
Sam is vegetarian and doesn't eat fish.
Mia and Sam's anniversary is June 3.
Mia broke up with her ex, Jordan, last year and doesn't want him brought up.
Mia dislikes horror movies but loves Studio Ghibli films.
Mia's favourite restaurant is Baan Suan, a Thai place on Queen Street.
Mia's 2021 MacBook Air battery has been draining fast.
Mia wants to run a half marathon in May and currently runs 25 km a week.
Mia hurt her left knee in October and her physio told her to cut her mileage.
Mia's rent is due on the 1st; her landlord Mr. Okafor prefers e-transfer.
Mia's mom's birthday is December 9 and she loves orchids.
Mia is saving for a down payment, aiming for 40k by the end of 2027.
Mia's best friend Priya is getting married in Vancouver in August, and Mia is a bridesmaid.
Mia reads before bed every night to wind down.
Mia gets migraines when she skips meals.
Mia's work project is a churn dashboard in Looker, due at the end of November.
Mia feels Raj micromanages her and is thinking about asking for more autonomy.
Mia switched from Android to an iPhone 15 in October.
Mia volunteers at a food bank every other Saturday morning.
Mia stopped drinking alcohol in January and orders kombucha at parties.
Mia's brother Tomas is 16 and she helps him with calculus homework.
Mia hates being called Mimi.
Mia's flight to Vancouver is AC 1207 on August 14.
Mia wants a standing desk because sitting all day gives her back pain.
Mia drives a 2015 Honda Civic and puts the winter tires on in mid-November.
Mia's in-person Japanese class is Wednesday at 7pm at the community centre.
Mia and Lena argued about their mom's care but made up in October.
Mia's neighbour Ellen feeds Biscuit when Mia travels.
Mia prefers texting over phone calls because calls stress her out.
Mia's annual performance review at Northwind is in March.
